	, CASE WHEN DATE_DIM.Previous_Business_Day is null then 1 else 0 end as ISLATEST

	, SOURCE_CODE
	, FILE_NAME

		, PROPERTY_ID

		, LCHG_TIME

		, AGE_OF_BULDING_YEARS
		, PROPERTY_EXP_DATE
		, PROPERTY_LEASED_FLG
		, PROPERTY_TITLE_OWNER
		, PROPERTY_PIN_CODE
		, PROPERTY_STATE
		, PROPERTY_CITY
		, PROPERTY_ADDRESS_2
		, PROPERTY_ADDRESS_1
		, PROPERTY_LAND_AREA
		, PROPERTY_BUILT_AREA
		, LAND_AREA_UNIT
		, BUILT_AREA_UNIT
		, PROPERTY_AREA_UNIT
		, PROPERTY_BUILDER_NAME
		, PROPERTY_DOCUMENT_NUM
		, SECU_CODE
		, isActive
		, isLatest
		, BNK_CODE
		, SOURCE_CODE
		, FILE_NAME
		, insert_dttm

		, CAST(Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE) START_DATE     
		, Max(Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) Over (PARTITION BY SECU_LINKAGE_TYPE, ACID, LIMIT_B2KID, SECU_SRL_NUM, BANK_ID
			ORDER BY Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) ROWS BETWEEN 1 Following AND 1 Following) END_DATE

	(

			, PURPOSE_OF_PROPERTY

			, STREET_NAME

			, BUILDING_LEVEL
			, PREMISE_NAME
			, HOUSE_NUM
			, PURPOSE_OF_USAGE
			, CONSTRUCTIONYR_IN_MTHS
			, CONSTRUCTIONYR_IN_YRS
			, PROPERTY_ADDRESS_3
			, BANK_ID
			, PROPERTY_RATING
			, PROPERTY_CNTRY
			, TS_CNT
			, RCRE_TIME

				over( partition by DEL_FLG
						, SECU_SRL_NUM
						, LIMIT_B2KID
						, ACID
						, SECU_LINKAGE_TYPE
						, LEASE_RENT
						, COLTRL_CRNCY_CODE
						, PROPERTY_ID
						, PURPOSE_OF_PROPERTY
						, PROPERTY_LOCATION
						, STREET_NAME

						, AGE_OF_BULDING_YEARS
						, PROPERTY_EXP_DATE
						, PROPERTY_LEASED_FLG
						, PROPERTY_TITLE_OWNER
						, PROPERTY_PIN_CODE
						, PROPERTY_STATE
						, PROPERTY_CITY
						, PROPERTY_ADDRESS_2
						, PROPERTY_ADDRESS_1
						, PROPERTY_LAND_AREA
						, PROPERTY_BUILT_AREA
